intro: I help middle and high school students find real opportunities nearby and online — jobs, internships, competitions, camps, scholarships and more — and build a plan to reach your goals.
ageHelp: We only ask for the year — never your full birthday. This keeps results right for your age.
tooYoung: Rumbo is made for students ages 11 to 18. Please ask a parent or teacher to help you find activities for your age.
tooOld: Rumbo is made for middle and high school students. You can still look around — results may not fit you.
parentTitle: A parent or guardian needs to say yes
parentWhy: You're under 13, so the law (COPPA) says a parent or guardian should agree before you use apps like this. Please hand your phone to your parent or guardian now.
parentSummary: Rumbo helps students find activities, competitions, scholarships and programs, and gives AI homework coaching that teaches step by step.
parentPoint1: No account, no full name, no address, no photos. Your child's information is saved only on this device.
parentPoint2: When your child searches, only their grade, age, interests and town are sent to our AI. Never their name.
parentPoint3: There is no private messaging. Group spaces are moderated and need a school code.
parentPoint4: You can turn features off with a PIN in Parental controls, and delete all data at any time.
parentCheckGuardian: I am this student's parent or legal guardian.
parentCheckAgree: I have read the summary above and I agree to let my child use Rumbo.
parentPinHelp: The PIN locks Parental controls so only you can change them.
parentApproval: Ask me before my child saves an opportunity
parentDeclined: That's okay. Rumbo won't be set up on this device. You can change your mind later.
profileTitle: Tell me a little about you
profileHelp: This helps me find better matches, so you don't have to retype it every time. You can change it later in Me.
nicknameHelp: Not your real name. Only you see it (and your school group, if you join one).
whereHelp: Your ZIP code or town helps find things nearby. We never ask for your address.
interestsHelp: Pick as many as you like.
transportQ: How do you usually get places?
transportCar: I can drive or have a car
transportRides: Family or friends give me rides
promise1: Your info stays on your phone.
promise2: I only show real opportunities with a link you can check. If I'm not sure, I'll say so.
promise4: If something serious is going on, I'll point you to people who can help.
